versions.description: Player vs player board games in chat: tic-tac-toe, connect-four and rock-paper-scissors. Challenge an online player, they accept or decline, the board is printed one chat line per row. Optional currency bet: both stakes are held until the end, the winner takes the pot, draws, declines and expired challenges are refunded. Turn reminders, turn timeouts, forfeit, stats and a leaderboard. Works on every game.

commands.name: challenge
commands.description: Challenge an online player to tic-tac-toe, connect-four or rock-paper-scissors, with an optional currency bet.
commands.helpText: challenge <player> <ttt|c4|rps> [bet] - the bet is taken now and held until the game ends.

arguments.name: player
arguments.helpText: Player name (full chat line is read, spaces allowed).

commands.name: accept
commands.description: Accept the board game challenge aimed at you. Your bet is held until the game ends.

commands.name: decline
commands.description: Decline the board game challenge aimed at you. The challenger gets their bet back.

commands.name: move
commands.description: Make your move: a square 1-9 (tic-tac-toe), a column 1-7 (connect-four) or rock/paper/scissors.

commands.name: board
commands.description: Show your current game, board and whose turn it is.

commands.name: forfeit
commands.description: Give up your running game (the other player wins the pot) or withdraw your open challenge (refunded).

commands.name: gamestats
commands.description: Show your board game wins, losses, draws and bet result, or another player's.

commands.name: gametop
commands.description: Board game leaderboard by wins, for all games or one game.

commands.name: boardgames
commands.description: How to play. Admins: boardgames list and boardgames cancel <player> (refunds all stakes).
commands.helpText: boardgames = help. boardgames list / boardgames cancel <player> need BOARD_GAMES_MANAGE.

arguments.name: action
arguments.helpText: Empty for help, list or cancel.

cronJobs.name: cbg-tick
cronJobs.description: Expires old challenges (refund), sends turn reminders and ends games where a player ran out of time.

functions.name: cbg-helpers

permissions.description: Allows listing running board games and cancelling one (all stakes refunded).
